entries.name: AM9517A DMA controller
entries.description: Programmable DMA controller with four channels, each with a base and a current address and word count, and a command, mode, request, mask, status and temporary register.
entries.behaviour: Sixteen registers selected by the low four address bits. The low eight are the channels' addresses and counts, read and written a byte at a time through one flip-flop; the high eight are command registers, several of them software commands.
